description: This PHP script handles OAuth2 authentication with Google, including obtaining authorization, handling callback, retrieving access tokens, and fetching user profile details.

classes.name: Google
classes.description: OAuth2 client provider class for Google used to handle OAuth2 authentication flows.

methods.name: getAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Generates the URL to redirect users for OAuth2 authorization.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state parameter used to prevent CSRF attacks.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token using authorization code or other OAuth2 grant types.

methods.name: getResourceOwner
methods.description: Fetches the resource owner (user) details using the access token.
